description:
Required Skills: 
 Technical skills should include strong Oracle, Performance Tuning, Data Warehousing, PL/SQL, Business Intelligence, and UNIX.
 Oracle application data tuning and optimization, development, and data modelling.
 Depends on a DBA. Someone who understands development concepts, can looks at indexes, explain plans and PL/SQL blocks and understand what it is, someone who worked in dev environments – sure.
 Database experience with good knowledge about performance tuning.
 Experienced in performance analysis and tuning, including the use of standard Oracle tools (Explain Plan, SQL Trace, ADDM/AWR) as well as third party solutions)
 Modeled, and created database objects, including partitioned tables, views, indexes, packages
 Developed original and/or complex PL/SQL code and provided coding guidance to less experienced staff
 
 4+ years of hands on experience in Oracle 12c/11g environment
 Experience in large (2+ TB) database tuning and optimization
 
 To know more on this position or to schedule an interview, please contact; 
 Mayank Kamble -  973-805-7532
